text_block_list.text: Heading up to the rooftop to eat lunch for a lunch meeting with Maruzensky—I heard a faint sobbing coming from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
Isn't this voice...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Rice-chan? Why are you out here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, umm... well--Rice,
ended up being the last thief...!

—Upon listening closely to the story, it turns out
she was playing cops and robbers with her friends
and ended up as the last one remaining.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even if I go to help, I might get caught too...!
And after they went through the trouble of inviting me...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I seeee. So that's why you got so sad,
thinking you might lose~.
Maruzensky looked down and spotted what appeared to be a cage near the center of the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Rice-chan, how many cops are there?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm... I'm pretty sure there was only one person...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that gives me an idea!
Big sis here will teach you a surefire winning strategy♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Which do you prefer: Plan A, a battle of pure stamina,
or Plan B, a contest of wits and strategy?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-A surefire way to win...!? U-Um... let's see...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... which one do you think is better...?
choice_data_list: Plan A: A battle of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪ In that case,
shall we go with Plan A?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, draw them in as close as possible and make them chase until they run completely out of stamina!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that something...
Rice can really do...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can definitely do it!
I know just how much stamina you have, Rice-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're a proud junior of mine—
hardworking, and full of grit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've got Maruzen-san's seal of approval,
so it's totally, completely all right-o!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Maruzen-san's stamp of approval...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Rice... um... will give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, thanks to that, I just came up with a great stamina-building menu♪

Afterward, from the rooftop, we could just barely
make out the small figure of Rice Shower
splendidly rescuing her friends.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪
In that case, let's go with the clever Plan B!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, the tactic is to lure them toward the complicated school buildings and shake them off in a dead end!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Could... could Rice really do something like that...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Of course you can!
You're great at thinking things through, aren't you, Rice?"
With that said, Maruzensky gently took both of Rice Shower's hands in hers.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If we calm down and think it through,
everything'll be totally A-OK! Right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Rice... will try her best...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, now that I've talked a big game to my junior,
I have to pull myself together too~.

Afterward, from the rooftop, we could just barely
make out the small figure of Rice Shower
splendidly rescuing her friends.
